items.title: Buttler injury halts England as Sri Lanka level series
items.description: Jos Buttler's bravery comes in vain as Sri Lanka fight back to beat England in the second one-day international at Headingley and set up a series decider at The Oval.

items.title: 'The lads wanted me to stick one up him' - Wood relives fastest spells
items.description: As England bowler Mark Wood retires from international cricket, he talks through his most famous spells from his Test career.

items.title: Mendis stars as Sri Lanka beat England to set up series decider
items.description: Kusal Mendis scores 121 to help Sri Lanka to a surprise win against England as they fought back to secure a 16-run victory against England at Headingley to level the three-match series and set up a decider at The Oval on Sunday.

items.title: 'He's changing the narrative' - Marvellous Mendis stars for Sri Lanka
items.description: Kusal Mendis produces a captain's innings at Headingley as he scores 121 off 100 balls to put Sri Lanka on course for a big score as they bat first against England in the second One Day International.

items.title: ODI Cricket
items.description: Could the series be decided as the two sides clash at Headingley?

items.title: Foxes relegated by Bears, subject to points appeal
items.description: Leicestershire are relegated, subject to an appeal against their points deduction, after being bowled out cheaply by title-chasing Warwickshire.

items.title: Somerset title hopes fade as Lawrence stars for Surrey
items.description: Dan Lawrence hits his sixth County Championship century of the season as Surrey dominate the opening day of the final Division One match with Somerset.

items.title: England's Gay hits 141 as Durham start well at Lancs
items.description: England opener Emilio Gay scores a stylish 141 for Durham, who end day one of their Division Two match against Lancashire on 355-5.

items.title: Late Yorkshire wickets halt Notts progress
items.description: Yorkshire take four wickets in the final 11 overs of day one at Trent Bridge to limit Nottinghamshire's first innings score.

items.title: Kent make good start against Gloucs in promotion bid
items.description: Kent remain in pole position for promotion from Division Two after they enjoy a good opening day against Gloucestershire.

items.title: Leaning leads Sussex recovery against Hampshire
items.description: Jack Leaning's aggressive half-century helps Sussex post 244 before they reduce Hampshire to 55-4 on day one of their Division One fixture.

items.title: England ease to big victory as Sri Lanka crumble in first ODI
items.description: England maintain their excellent one-day form in a comfortable victory against Sri Lanka, as Will Jacks' stars with bat and ball to help the home side to an 89-run win at Chester-le-Street in the first ODI.

items.title: Vital with the bat, crucial with the ball - Jacks stars in England win
items.description: Will Jacks produces a match-winning performance to help England to a comfortable 89-run victory over Sri Lanka at Chester-le-Street in the first one-day international of the three-match series.

items.title: Dream debut - Colombage takes three wickets to stifle England
items.description: Sachindu Colombage enjoys a debut to remember as he removes Joe Root, Jos Buttler and Jamie Overton to finish with figures of 3-44 in the first One Day International between England and Sri Lanka at Chester-le-Street.

items.title: England thump Sri Lanka to sweep T20 series 3-0
items.description: England steamroll Sri Lanka to complete a 3-0 series clean sweep and return to number one in the T20 world rankings.

items.title: England beat Sri Lanka by six wickets to take T20 series win
items.description: England's impressive T20 form continues as they thrash Sri Lanka by six wickets in Cardiff to seal the series with a match to spare.

items.title: Pick your County Championship team of the season
items.description: Pick you best XI from the 2026 County Championship season. Who makes the cut?

items.title: Northants promotion hopes dented after Lord's collapse
items.description: Northamptonshire's hopes of promotion from Division Two fade following a poor opening day against Middlesex.

items.title: Leicestershire to appeal against 27-point penalty
items.description: Leicestershire are to appeal against the 27-point ECB penalty they received for breaching pitch regulations in August.

items.title: Essex cricketer Das charged with two counts of rape
items.description: Essex cricketer Robin Das is charged with two counts of rape and will appear in court in October.

items.title: 'It was scary' - Jacks goes from emergency surgery to match-winner
items.description: Will Jacks' career-best 50-over figures on Tuesday came shortly after the England all-rounder was rushed into hospital for emergency surgery while on a weekend away.

items.title: Abbas & Allison shine as wickets tumble at New Road
items.description: Muhammad Abbas and Ben Allison take five wickets each as 20 wickets fall on day one, which ends with Worcestershire 131 ahead against Derbyshire.

items.title: Stumped
items.description: After a career blighted by injuries Mark Wood calls time on international career.

items.title: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe lost their husbands - this is their story
items.description: Debbie Beard and Amanda Thorpe speak to the BBC's Simon Jack at the launch of a new suicide prevention toolkit.

items.title: Glamorgan in control as Tribe and Carlson impress against Essex
items.description: Asa Tribe and Kiran Carlson put Glamorgan in a commanding position against Essex on the opening day of their final County Championship match.

items.title: India avoid shock defeat by Japan after controversial wide
items.description: World Champions India avoid a shock defeat in the one-off T20 against Japan after a wide ball is controversially overturned in the final over.

items.title: Carse needs time away, says 'good mate' Brook
items.description: England white-ball captain Harry Brook says his "very good mate" Brydon Carse needs time away from international cricket.

items.title: What's gone wrong at Lancashire?
items.description: Lancashire are set to end 2026 in the bottom two of Division Two, their lowest-ever finish in the County Championship.

items.title: Fleming on England discipline, Stokes, late arrival and coaching styles
items.description: Read what England's new Test coach Stephen Fleming had to say about Bazball, Ben Stokes, the team's discipline issues and his own philosophy.

items.title: Northamptonshire all-rounder Miller extends deal
items.description: Northamptonshire all-rounder Gus Miller signs a one-year contract extension to stay with the county until the end of 2027.
